pairs.subject: concurrency-guards
pairs.evidence: src/features/inflight/live/useShipLoop.ts:50 The 90s monitor refresh and the accept/reject actions both overwrite the ship-loop state with whatever response lands last and carry no generation or attempt id, so a refresh that started before an accept and lands after it brings the accepted triage row back until the next tick.

techniques.evidence: src/features/inflight/live/useShipLoop.ts:50 Nothing is checked at the write site. The refresh poll and act() both call setState(d.state), so the last response to arrive wins and a stale poll can roll back a newer action result.

src/features/inflight/live/liveWarRoomLaunch.ts:36 Each guard is hand-rolled: abortRef null-check for scans, a busy map for triage, share.busy for links. The scan refusal returns nothing, so an auto-verify rescan is dropped without telling anyone (useLiveWarRoom.ts:118 says so). The refresh poll has no in-flight guard at all.

src/features/inflight/live/useShipLoop.ts:72 The triage busy guard is keyed per recommendationId, the narrowest identity that still catches a double accept/reject. Unrelated rows are not serialized behind it.

src/features/inflight/live/useShipLoop.ts:91 The busy entry is released in finally, so it is cleared on success, on a non-ok response and on a network error. Caveat: runLiveScan's finally (liveWarRoomLaunch.ts:96) clears abortRef without checking that it still owns it.
src/features/inflight/live/useLiveWarRoom.ts:64 The scan guard is held across the fetch and SSE awaits, and the unmount cleanup names what releases it if the unit is destroyed at that suspension.

src/features/inflight/live/liveWakeLock.ts:17 acquireWakeLock stores the sentinel after awaiting wakeLock.request without re-reading wakeHeld. If the wall exits (releaseWakeLock) while the request is pending, the late sentinel is kept and the screen lock leaks with no listener left to release it.

pairs.subject: concurrency-guards
pairs.evidence: src/components/ui/format.ts:2 These are synchronous presentational primitives (formatters, an IntersectionObserver reveal, an html-class scroll-snap toggle); searching src/components/deck and src/components/ui for AbortController, inFlight, mutex, idempot and fetch( found no hits in source, so no operation here can be reached twice concurrently or needs a guard.
